name: Payment Custom  Search Restriction
description: Payment Search Restriction provides administrators with flexible control over advanced search features in the Odoo Payment module. The access right can be assigned to individual users to determine whether advanced search options are available. When Payment Advanced Search is set to No, the assigned user cannot create custom filters or custom grouping in Payment views. When the access right is enabled, users can create custom filters, apply domains, and use grouping options according to their requirements. This approach helps administrators control advanced search capabilities while keeping standard Payment access rights and workflows unchanged.
summary: Payment Search Restriction provides a simple and effective way to control advanced search capabilities in the Odoo Payment module. It allows administrators to assign the Payment Advanced Search access right to individual users based on their responsibilities. Users without the assigned permission cannot access advanced search options such as custom filters, custom domains, and custom grouping. Authorized users can use these advanced search features to efficiently find, filter, and organize payment records. The module helps maintain a controlled and user-friendly Payment interface by limiting unnecessary search functionality. It works independently of standard Payment access rights and does not modify existing Odoo security permissions. This solution is useful for organizations that require user-specific control over payment search and grouping features. Payment Search Restriction improves data management, access control, and search flexibility within the Odoo Payment module.

name: Payment View Type Restriction
description: Payment View Type Restriction allows administrators to control the availability of the View Type option in the Payments interface for individual users. When the restriction is enabled for a user, the View Type option is removed from the Payment view, preventing the user from changing or selecting different view types from that interface. This provides a simple and effective way to manage the Payment interface according to user roles and financial responsibilities. The module works independently of the user's existing Payment access rights and standard Odoo security permissions.
summary: Payment View Type Restriction provides a practical solution for managing the View Type option in the Odoo Payments module. It allows administrators to control the visibility of the View Type option for individual users according to their roles and responsibilities. When the restriction is enabled, the View Type option is hidden from the selected user's Payment interface. This prevents users from changing or selecting different Payment views directly from the interface. The module works independently of existing Payment access rights and standard Odoo security permissions. It helps maintain a clean and consistent Payments interface while keeping standard Odoo payment functionality unchanged. The feature focuses only on View Type option visibility and does not restrict individual Payment views.
